import seaborn as sns

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert 'StichtagDat' column to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a bar chart to show the most common breeds
most_common_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=most_common_breeds.index, y=most_common_breeds.values, palette='Blues_d')
plt.title('Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show the age distribution of dogs
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterV10Sort'], bins=20, kde=True, palette='Blues_d')
plt.title('Age Distribution of Dogs in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a heatmap to show the relationship between age and district
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.set(font_scale=1)
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
corr_matrix = data[['AlterV10Sort', 'KreisCd']].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Relationship between Age and District')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
